title: Houthis Claim Third Drone Attack on Aramco's Jazan Refinery in Two Weeks
detail: Yemen's Iran-aligned Houthi movement claimed its forces struck Saudi Aramco's 400,000-bpd Jazan refinery on the Red Sea coast with 'a number of drones' in what it called a precise operation, in retaliation for alleged Saudi violations of Yemeni airspace over Saada and Hajjah. It was the third claimed attack on the facility in roughly two weeks after strikes in late July forced Aramco to shut the refinery; officials had pushed the restart date back from mid-August to around August 30. Saudi Arabia issued no official confirmation of impact.

media.caption: Houthi drone strike claims target Aramco's Jazan refinery for the third time in two weeks

confidenceReason: Attack claimed by Houthi military spokesperson via Saba news agency; no independent Saudi or Aramco confirmation of impact was available.
